Typically, there is also an `ofMedium` relation between the observed `Property` and the `Substance-Medium` (see Figures 10-9 and 10-10). de1da1b823a0e7cc634cff68d10116f25f3ab9cb.label: has process
de1da1b823a0e7cc634cff68d10116f25f3ab9cb.name: has_process

e0ce2acc567890d049fb24b4281eb87811ce9578.definition: A unique value that is assigned to an enumeration member.
e0ce2acc567890d049fb24b4281eb87811ce9578.label: code
e0ce2acc567890d049fb24b4281eb87811ce9578.name: code

e5bd157b39bd24e315efd3f84847268768ce0f5b.definition: A `Relation` that associates a control setpoint with the `QuantifiableProperty` indicating the desired value which the control process is trying to maintain.
e5bd157b39bd24e315efd3f84847268768ce0f5b.label: has setpoint
e5bd157b39bd24e315efd3f84847268768ce0f5b.name: has_setpoint

e9d34b66df828a0a70289fdffc969528a4901a59.definition: The relation `connectedTo` indicates that connectable things are `connected` with a specific direction of flow. A is `connectedTo` B, means a direction of flow from A to B.  The inverse direction is indicated by `connectedFrom` (see {s223:connectedFrom}).
e9d34b66df828a0a70289fdffc969528a4901a59.label: connected to
e9d34b66df828a0a70289fdffc969528a4901a59.name: connected_to

f0c6e544cf6e2b0a381553c94579f7b5d2a15d0e.definition: A reference to the `QuantityKind` of a `QuantifiableProperty` of interest, such as `Temperature`.
f0c6e544cf6e2b0a381553c94579f7b5d2a15d0e.label: has quantity kind
f0c6e544cf6e2b0a381553c94579f7b5d2a15d0e.name: has_quantity_kind

f292814fc76843ca4ebe0052d116f5117d38826a.definition: A reference to the `QuantityKind` of a `QuantifiableProperty` of interest, such as `Temperature`.
f292814fc76843ca4ebe0052d116f5117d38826a.label: has quantity kind
f292814fc76843ca4ebe0052d116f5117d38826a.name: has_quantity_kind

f4801994741c6f966ec468e9ba76b12b768c1467.definition: Relates a process type to the treatment objective it achieves wherever it is performed. Used to derive an equipment's treatment objective from its process.
f4801994741c6f966ec468e9ba76b12b768c1467.label: achieves treatment objective
f4801994741c6f966ec468e9ba76b12b768c1467.name: achieves_treatment_objective

f7a112380c5da560c19b5f433a7f87184e1c1e57.definition: Relates a compound process to a constituent process that a system performing it is expected to carry out, typically through a member. Used to check coverage, not validity.
f7a112380c5da560c19b5f433a7f87184e1c1e57.label: includes process
f7a112380c5da560c19b5f433a7f87184e1c1e57.name: includes_process

fa3e78cdb027a741df9a1712314bec92abba3995.definition: The `hasTemporalRange` relation is used to link to a numerical `Property` whose value indicates the start and end times for which data has been recorded.
fa3e78cdb027a741df9a1712314bec92abba3995.label: has temporal range
fa3e78cdb027a741df9a1712314bec92abba3995.name: has_temporal_range

fa57da9c85327ebae16fc6f22c94773f427d150d.definition: Associates a water treatment process with the entity that performs it: a piece of Equipment, or an s223:System where the process is performed by the collection and by no individual member (backwashing, or a treatment train such as an MLE). See watr:ProcessBearerShape and watr:ProcessValueShape.
fa57da9c85327ebae16fc6f22c94773f427d150d.label: has process
fa57da9c85327ebae16fc6f22c94773f427d150d.name: has_process

fb03c4647c78ea5b5479992086c381bfe9c64497.label: dimension exponent for amount of substance
fb03c4647c78ea5b5479992086c381bfe9c64497.name: dimension_exponent_for_amount_of_substance

fb14235aedae9dc0bc73b677677785209d30e2fb.definition: A `Relation` that associates a `Controller` (see {s223:Controller}) with the `Function`s (see {s223:Function}) that it executes.
fb14235aedae9dc0bc73b677677785209d30e2fb.label: executes
fb14235aedae9dc0bc73b677677785209d30e2fb.name: executes

fb576b662e50284c18d40450bf9a7a3b53ef1115.definition: The `hasNumericResolution` relation is used to link to a numerical `Property` whose value indicates the smallest distinguishable difference between two measured values in engineering units.
fb576b662e50284c18d40450bf9a7a3b53ef1115.label: has numeric resolution
fb576b662e50284c18d40450bf9a7a3b53ef1115.name: has_numeric_resolution

fb728893059403b65b5af9a441215ab3997bfc66.definition:
A `Relation` that associates a `Sensor` with one `ObservableProperty` (see {s223:ObservableProperty})
which is used by the sensor to generate a measurement value (e.g., a temperature) or a simple observation of a stimulus
causing a reaction (e.g., a current binary switch that closes a dry contact when a fan is powered on).
fb728893059403b65b5af9a441215ab3997bfc66.label: observes
fb728893059403b65b5af9a441215ab3997bfc66.name: observes

views.definition:
A piece of `Equipment` that receives control signals and electrically, pneumatically, or hydraulically makes changes in the
physical world, such as the position of a valve or damper.
views.label: Actuator
views.name: Actuator

views.definition:
A piece of `Equipment` consisting of a fan or fans and other equipment necessary to perform one or more of the following functions:
circulating, filtration, heating, cooling, heat recovery, humidifying, dehumidifying, and mixing of air.
views.label: Air handling unit
views.name: AirHandlingUnit

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that transfers heat from one air stream to another while keeping the two media separate.
views.label: Air heat exchanger
views.name: AirHeatExchanger

views.definition: A `HeatPump` that transfers thermal energy between two bodies of air.
views.label: Air-to-air heat pump
views.name: AirToAirHeatPump

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` for bathing that receives as an input hot or cold water dispensed from one or two `Faucet`s, and is designed to hold a specific volume of water and release the held water through a `Drain`.
views.label: Bathtub
views.name: Bathtub

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that stores a defined amount of chemical energy that can be converted to electrical energy via a chemical process. This process, typically referred to as discharging, produces a specific electrical voltage and current.
views.label: Battery
views.name: Battery_2

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that uses fuel or electricity to heat water or other fluids and supply steam or hot water for heating, humidification, or other applications.
views.label: Boiler
views.name: Boiler_2

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` with a colder surface temperature where air passes through, and air movement is induced in the room to achieve cooling. Cooling medium is generally water.
views.label: Chilled beam
views.name: ChilledBeam

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that removes heat from a liquid coolant via a vapor-compression, adsorption refrigeration, or absorption refrigeration cycles.
views.label: Chiller
views.name: Chiller

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that automatically cleans a load of textiles (e.g., clothing, bedding).
views.label: Clothes washer
views.name: ClothesWasher

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that automatically brews coffee.
views.label: Coffee maker
views.name: CoffeeMaker

views.definition:
A piece of `Equipment` consisting of a pipe or tube that is formed into a helical or serpentine shape, may or may not be finned, and is used in cooling or heating equipment.

A `Coil` shall conform to exactly one of the following patterns:

- **Pattern 1:**
  - The `Coil` has exactly two inlet connection points using the medium `Mix-Fluid`, with exactly one being `Fluid-Air`.
  - The `Coil` has exactly two outlet connection points using the medium `Mix-Fluid`, with exactly one being `Fluid-Air`.

- **Pattern 2:**
  - The Coil has exactly one inlet connection point using the medium `Mix-Fluid`.
  - The Coil has exactly one outlet connection point using the medium `Mix-Fluid`.
  - The Coil has one or two bidirectional connection points using the medium `Mix-Fluid` or `Medium-ThermalContact`.

- **Pattern 3:**
  - The Coil has exactly three bidirectional connection points using the medium `Mix-Fluid` or `Medium-ThermalContact`.
views.label: Coil
views.name: Coil

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that mechanically increases the pressure of a gas.
views.label: Compressor
views.name: Compressor_2

views.definition:
A piece of `Equipment` that can be programmed to automatically carry out sequences of arithmetic or logical operations (computation).
Modern digital electronic computers can perform generic sets of operations known as programs. These programs enable computers to perform a
wide range of tasks.
views.label: Computer
views.name: Computer

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that processes an input electrical or RF signal, typically from a `Computer`, and outputs a durable representation of information, typically text and/or graphics, typically on paper.
views.label: Computer printer
views.name: ComputerPrinter

views.definition:
A `Sensor` that `observes` a `QuantifiableObservableProperty` that represents a concentration of a miscible constituent in a medium,
in contrast to a `ParticulateSensor` that `observes` a `QuantifiableObservableProperty` that represents an amount of a particulate in a medium
(see {s223:ParticulateSensor}). The 223 standard does not constrain the `Unit` or `QuantityKind` reported by a `ConcentrationSensor`, but possible
`QuantityKind`s include `Concentration` (moles per volume), `Density` (mass per volume), `MoleFraction`, and `VolumeFraction`.
views.label: Concentration sensor
views.name: ConcentrationSensor_2

views.definition: `Connectable` is an abstract class representing `Equipment` (see {s223:Equipment}), a `DomainSpace` (see {s223:DomainSpace}), or a `Junction` (see {s223:Junction}) that can be `connected` to other `Connectable`s via `ConnectionPoint`s and `Connection`s.
views.label: Connectable
views.name: Connectable

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that regulates the normal operation of other `Equipment` by executing one or more `Function`s.
views.label: Controller
views.name: Controller_2

views.definition: A `Coil` that is specifically used to cool air.
views.label: Cooling coil
views.name: CoolingCoil

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that uses atmospheric air to cool warm water, generally by direct contact via evaporation.
views.label: Cooling tower
views.name: CoolingTower

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that processes an input of one or more durable representation(s) of information, typically text and/or graphics and typically on paper, and outputs one or more reproductions of the information for each input, typically on paper.
views.label: Copy machine
views.name: CopyMachine

views.definition:
A `LightSensor` that `observes` a `QuantifiableObservableProperty` that represents a correlated color temperature (CCT) of a
light source, defined as the absolute temperature of a blackbody whose chromaticity most nearly resembles that of the light source.
views.label: Correlated color temperature sensor
views.name: CorrelatedColorTemperatureSensor

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` inserted into an air distribution system permitting modification of the air resistance of the system and consequently changing the airflow rate or shutting off the airflow.
views.label: Damper
views.name: Damper

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that automatically cleans dishware, cookware, and cutlery.
views.label: Dishwasher
views.name: Dishwasher

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` consisting of hinged, sliding, or revolving barrier at the entrance to a building or room.
views.label: Door
views.name: Door

views.definition: A `Valve` that allows, regulates, or stops the flow of water from a `Sink`, `Shower`, `Bathtub`, or other plumbing service equipment into a plumbing drainage system that typically carries the mixture to a sewer system or septic tank.
views.label: Drain
views.name: Drain

views.definition: A `TerminalUnit` that mixes two independent sources of primary air.
views.label: Dual duct terminal
views.name: DualDuctTerminal

views.definition:
A `LightSensor` that `observes` a `QuantifiableObservableProperty` that represents a Duv of a light source, defined as the
distance between the chromaticity of the light source and a blackbody radiator of equal correlated color temperature (CCT).
views.label: Duv sensor
views.name: DuvSensor

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that automatically removes moisture from a load of textiles (e.g., clothing, bedding), typically after they are washed in a `ClothesWasher`.
views.label: Electric clothes dryer
views.name: ElectricClothesDryer

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` with a flat surface containing one or more heat sources designed for cooking with pots and pans.
views.label: Electric cooktop
views.name: ElectricCooktop

views.definition: A `Sensor` that `observes` a `QuantifiableObservableProperty` that represents a measure of electric current.
views.label: Electric current sensor
views.name: ElectricCurrentSensor

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that converts one form of electric power to another form of electric power.
views.label: Electric energy converter
views.name: ElectricEnergyConverter

views.definition: An `ElectricEnergyConverter` that transforms direct current (DC) electric power from one voltage to another voltage.
views.label: DC-DC converter
views.name: ElectricEnergyDCDCConverter

views.definition: An `ElectricEnergyConverter` that tranforms direct current (DC) electric power to alternating current (AC) electric power, or vice versa.
views.label: Electric energy inverter
views.name: ElectricEnergyInverter

views.definition: An `ElectricEnergyConverter` that transforms alternating current (AC) electric power from one voltage to another voltage.
views.label: Electric energy transformer
views.name: ElectricEnergyTransformer

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` with an enclosed chamber designed for baking, roasting, and other cooking methods that rely on circulating heat.
views.label: Electric oven
views.name: ElectricOven

views.definition:
A piece of `Equipment` that provides electrical resistance heating, for example an electric heating coil within a Fan Coil Unit.
It shall have one electricity `InletConnectionPoint`, and fit one of the following two patterns:

- Pattern 1: An `ElectricResistanceElement` shall have exactly one Bidirectional `ConnectionPoint` using the medium `Mix-Fluid`.
- Pattern 2: An `ElectricResistanceElement` shall have one inlet and one outlet using the medium `Mix-Fluid`.
views.label: Electric resistance element
views.name: ElectricResistanceElement

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that dispenses water and optionally heats and/or cools the water prior to dispensing.
views.label: Electric water dispenser
views.name: ElectricWaterDispenser

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that automatically opens an electric circuit automatically at a predetermined overcurrent, so as to prevent damage to the circuit, the equipment connected to the circuit, and the building containing the circuit.
views.label: Electricity breaker
views.name: ElectricityBreaker

views.definition:
A piece of `Equipment` that contains at least one `VoltageSensor` and one `ElectricCurrentSensor`, and reports one or more
properties of electricity. Example reported properties include the following `QuantityKind`s: `Voltage`, `ElectricCurrent`, `ActiveEnergy`,
`ActivePower`, `ReactivePower`, `ApparentPower`, `PowerFactor`, and `Frequency` with unit Hertz. An `ElectricityMeter` may optionally contain a `Function` that represents the mathematical calculations of the reported properties of electricity.
views.label: Electricity meter
views.name: ElectricityMeter

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that contains one or more receptacles for connecting electrical equipment to electrical power, typically via a plug and cord. Not to be confused with an `OutletConnectionPoint` with the medium `Constituent-Electricity`.
views.label: Electricity outlet
views.name: ElectricityOutlet

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that receives an input electrical signal and outputs information, typically text and/or graphics, in a visual form.
views.label: Electronic display
views.name: ElectronicDisplay

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that vertically transports people or freight between floors or levels of a building via a vertical shaft commonly referred to as a hoistway. The people or freight are typically situated on a platform, or in a container commonly referred to as a car, cab, cabin, cage, or carriage.
views.label: Elevator
views.name: Elevator

views.definition:
`Equipment` is the modeling construct used to represent a thing designed to accomplish a specific task, or a complex thing
that contains component pieces of `Equipment` that are connected to each other and work together to accomplish a task. `Equipment` can have
`Connection`s and `ConnectionPoint`s through which one or more kinds of medium (see {s223:Substance-Medium}) might flow. Examples of `Equipment` defined in this ontology include `Pump`, `Fan`, `AirHeatExchanger`, `Luminaire`, and `Sensor`. `Equipment` can be connected to other `Connectable`s such as other `Equipment` or `DomainSpace`s.

The graphical depiction of Equipment used in this document is a round-cornered rectangle as shown in Figure 5-1.

![Graphical Depiction of Equipment.](figures/Figure_5-1_Graphical_Depiciton_of_Equipment.svg)
views.label: Equipment
views.name: Equipment

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that vertically transports people between floors or levels of a building via a moving staircase.
views.label: Escalator
views.name: Escalator

views.definition:
A piece of `Equipment` that connects a single instance of electrical equipment, such as `Computer`s and Wi-Fi access points,
to an Ethernet network so it can communicate with other equipment and, optionally, with the Internet.
views.label: Ethernet port
views.name: EthernetPort

views.definition:
A piece of `Equipment` that connects one or more instances of electrical equipment, such as `Computer`s and Wi-Fi access points,
to an Ethernet network so they can communicate with each other and, optionally, to the Internet.
views.label: Ethernet switch
views.name: EthernetSwitch

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that causes a gas (e.g., air) to flow.
views.label: Fan
views.name: Fan

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` consisting of a `Coil` and a `Fan` that regulates the temperature of one or more spaces.
views.label: Fan coil unit
views.name: FanCoilUnit

views.definition: A `TerminalUnit` that contains a fan, and optionally has supplemental heating or cooling. Airflow may pass through or be parallel to the fan.
views.label: Fan-powered terminal
views.name: FanPoweredTerminal

views.definition: A `Valve` that allows, regulates, or stops the flow of hot or cold water from a plumbing supply system into a `Sink`, `Shower`, `Bathtub`, or other plumbing service equipment.
views.label: Faucet
views.name: Faucet

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that contains one or more receptacles for connecting electrical equipment to a fiber Ethernet communication network, typically via a fiber Ethernet cable.
views.label: Fiber Ethernet outlet
views.name: FiberEthernetOutlet

views.definition:
A piece of `Equipment` that removes contaminants from gases or liquids. See {s223:Substance-Medium} for
more details on validating compatible mediums upstream and downstream of a `Filter`.
views.label: Filter
views.name: Filter_2

views.definition: A `Sensor` that `observes` a `QuantifiableObservableProperty` that represents a measure of flow of fluid, typically with a `QuantityKind` of `VolumeFlowRate`.
views.label: Flow sensor
views.name: FlowSensor_2

views.definition:
A piece of `Equipment` that collects human waste (i.e., urine and/or feces, and sometimes toilet paper) in a chamber containing water,
and contains an integral manual or automatic actuator that triggers the release of an additional volume of water that flushes everything from the chamber into
a drainage system that typically carries the mixture to a sewer system or septic tank.
views.label: Flush toilet
views.name: FlushToilet

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that maintains an internal temperature below the freezing point of water.
views.label: Freezer
views.name: Freezer

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that is typically mounted over a work area (e.g., a space, table, or shelf) and conducts unwanted gases away from the area.
views.label: Fume hood
views.name: FumeHood

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that converts fuel or electrical energy into heat.
views.label: Furnace
views.name: Furnace

views.definition:
A `PressureSensor` that `observes` a `QuantifiableObservableProperty` that represents a measure of pressure relative to atmospheric pressure.
Such sensors are commonly used to monitor compressed gas cylinders, for example, where a gauge reading of zero signifies that the measured pressure
is equal to the atmospheric pressure, not a vacuum.
views.label: Gauge pressure sensor
views.name: GaugePressureSensor

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that converts non-electric energy into electric energy.
views.label: Generator
views.name: Generator

views.definition: A `HeatPump` that transfers thermal energy between air and the ground.
views.label: Ground-to-air heat pump
views.name: GroundToAirHeatPump

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that heats or cools spaces by transferring thermal energy from one thermal environment to another using a reversible refrigeration cycle.
views.label: Heat pump
views.name: HeatPump

views.definition: A `Coil` that is specifically used to heat air.
views.label: Heating coil
views.name: HeatingCoil

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that adds moisture to a gas (e.g., air).
views.label: Humidifier
views.name: Humidifier

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that measures the relative humidity of the air and then uses this information to automatically adjust the amount of moisture in air.
views.label: Humidistat
views.name: Humidistat

views.definition: A `Sensor` that `observes` a `QuantifiableObservableProperty` that represents a measure of relative or absolute humidity.
views.label: Humidity sensor
views.name: HumiditySensor

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that transfers heat from one liquid stream to another while keeping the two media separate.
views.label: Hydronic heat exchanger
views.name: HydronicHeatExchanger

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that makes ice.
views.label: Ice maker
views.name: IceMaker

views.definition:
A `LightSensor` that `observes` a `QuantifiableObservableProperty` that represents an illuminance, defined as the areal density of the
luminous flux incident at a point on a surface.
views.label: Illuminance sensor
views.name: IlluminanceSensor

views.definition: A `Sensor` that `observes` a `QuantifiableObservableProperty` that represents an attribute of light, as specified by the `QuantityKind` of the `Property` being observed, as described in Clauses 5.6.5.1 through 5.6.5.3.
views.label: Light sensor
views.name: LightSensor

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` consisting of a light source(s) and ballast(s) or driver(s) (when applicable), together with the parts designed to distribute the light, to position and protect the light source(s), and to connect the light source(s) to the power supply. Also known as a light fixture.
views.label: Luminaire
views.name: Luminaire

views.definition: An `ElectricOven` that cooks food by exposing it to electromagnetic radiation in the microwave frequency range.
views.label: Microwave oven
views.name: MicrowaveOven

views.definition: An `ElectronicDisplay` designed primarily for the output of visual information supplied by a `Computer`.
views.label: Monitor
views.name: Monitor

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that converts electrical energy into mechanical energy.
views.label: Motor
views.name: Motor

views.definition: A `Sensor` that `observes` an `ObservableProperty` that represents an attribute of occupancy in a space.
views.label: Occupancy sensor
views.name: OccupancySensor

views.definition:
An `OccupancySensor` that `observes` a `QuantifiableObservableProperty` that represents a population, usually of humans, within
  a sensing region.
views.label: Occupant count sensor
views.name: OccupantCountSensor

views.definition: An `OccupancySensor` that `observes` an `EnumeratedObservableProperty` that represents motion within a sensing region.
views.label: Occupant motion sensor
views.name: OccupantMotionSensor

views.definition: An `OccupancySensor` that `observes` an `EnumeratedObservableProperty` that represents presence within a sensing region.
views.label: Occupant presence sensor
views.name: OccupantPresenceSensor

views.definition:
A `Sensor` that `observes` a `QuantifiableObservableProperty` that represents an amount of a particulate in a medium, in contrast
to a `ConcentrationSensor` that `observes` a `QuantifiableObservableProperty` that represents a concentration of a miscible constituent in a medium
(see {s223:ConcentrationSensor}).

The 223 standard does not constrain the `Unit` or `QuantityKind` reported by a `ParticulateSensor`, but possible
`QuantityKind`s include `Density` (mass per volume), `ParticleNumberDensity` (count per volume), and `DimensionlessRatio` (with units such as `PPM` or
`PPB`). Some particulate sensors may claim to report a raw count of particles, for which a `QuantityKind` of `Count` could be used, but the required
context for such a measurement should be provided in the sensor's documentation to specify if it in fact measures a count per volume (e.g., `ParticleNumberDensity`),
time (e.g., `CountRate` or `ParticleCurrent`), or some
other combination. Explicitly declaring the `QuantityKind` of a sensor's output is preferable to relying on implicit assumptions.
views.label: Particulate sensor
views.name: ParticulateSensor

views.definition: A `Computer` designed primarily for use by a single person.
views.label: Personal computer
views.name: PersonalComputer

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that converts sunlight into electricity.
views.label: Photovoltaic module
views.name: PhotovoltaicModule

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that connects and is capable of powering one instance of electrical equipment, such as computers and Wi-Fi access points, as well as connect it to an Ethernet network so it can communicate with other equipment and, optionally, with the Internet.
views.label: Power over ethernet port
views.name: PowerOverEthernetPort

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that connects and is capable of powering one or more instances of electrical equipment, such as computers and Wi-Fi access points, as well as connect the equipment to an Ethernet network so they can communicate with each other and, optionally, to the Internet.
views.label: Power over Ethernet (PoE) switch
views.name: PowerOverEthernetSwitch

views.definition: A `Sensor` that `observes` a `QuantifiableObservableProperty` that represents a measure of pressure.
views.label: Pressure sensor
views.name: PressureSensor_2

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that imparts energy to a fluid, drawing a fluid into itself through an inlet port, and forcing the fluid out through an outlet port.
views.label: Pump
views.name: Pump_2

views.definition: This class is for instances of `QuantifiableProperty` for which numerical values are specified to be modifiable by a user or a machine outside of the model, like a setpoint.
views.label: Quantifiable actuatable property
views.name: QuantifiableActuatableProperty

views.definition: This class is for instances of `QuantifiableProperty` for which numerical values are observed, like a temperature reading or a voltage measure.
views.label: Quantifiable observable property
views.name: QuantifiableObservableProperty

views.definition: This class is for quantifiable values that describe an object (`System`, `Equipment`, etc.) that are typically static (`hasValue`). That is, they are neither measured nor specified in the course of operations.
views.label: Quantifiable property
views.name: QuantifiableProperty

views.definition: A piece of `Equipment` that contains one or more receptacles for connecting electrical equipment to a radio frequency (RF) communication network, via, for example, a coaxial cable.
views.label: Radio frequency outlet
views.name: RFOutlet

views.definition:
A piece of `Equipment` with heating or cooling surface that delivers 50% or more of its heat transfer by radiation.
A `RadiantHeater` shall:

- Have the role `Role-Heating`.

- Have at least one outlet connection point using the medium `Light-Infrared`.

- Conform to exactly one of the following patterns:
  - **Pattern 1:**
